g.sub: French space surveillance radar at Broye-lès-Pesmes, JN27SI (47.348° N 5.515° E). Four phased arrays cover the southern sky from 90° to 270° in four 45° sectors (D, C, B, A) of 6 steps of 7.5°, lit one after another. Hearing it by tropo is hard, but it can happen.

c.title: Changes to CALL3.TXT
c.help: CALL3.TXT is never touched: changes live in two layers on top of it. Entries typed here win over everything, even the locator the station sends. Added files (same CALL,LOCATOR format) win over CALL3.TXT; with several files the last in alphabetical order wins. Callsigns with a slash (IV3/HB9CAT, F/IC8TEM) are written as they are.
x.long: Beyond the ring from QTH: squares only
s.d.cluster: In DM4X and RBN automatic spots the first locator (e.g. KN09tp<>KN09) is the one the spotting station declares for itself. If it has 6 characters and the database says otherwise, the program corrects it in Dati/CALL3-CLUSTER.TXT. Manual entries always win. Information only.
